cues.en: Mike: Now I'm going to tell you how to compute the beta coefficient, how to solve the general linear model equation.
cues.zh: Mike：現在介紹如何計算 beta 係數，也就是求解一般線性模型方程式。

cues.en: Now, this requires a little bit of background to totally understand all the math that I'm going to discuss in this video.
cues.zh: 要完全理解這支影片的所有數學，需要一點背景。

cues.en: I'm gonna try to explain it so that it makes sense conceptually, even if you are not comfortable with linear algebra.
cues.zh: 我會盡量從概念上說清楚，即使不熟悉線性代數，也能理解。

cues.en: Of course, if you're interested in learning more about linear algebra, you can consider taking my course on linear algebra Apologies for the shameless self-promotion.
cues.zh: 如果有興趣多學線性代數，可以考慮我的線性代數課。抱歉，毫不掩飾地自我推銷了。

cues.en: But anyway, so even if you are not comfortable with all the math, there are some important concepts that I'm going to discuss in this video.
cues.zh: 總之，即使不熟悉全部數學，這支影片仍會討論一些重要概念。

cues.en: So please watch the video even if you are not totally familiar with the math background.
cues.zh: 所以就算背景不夠熟悉，也請看這支影片。

cues.en: So here is our equation again, and you'll see in a moment why there's this huge gap here.
cues.zh: 這裡又是方程式，稍後就知道為什麼留了這麼大的空白。

cues.en: So we have y=x beta.
cues.zh: y 等於 X beta。

cues.en: So x is our design matrix, where the columns of this matrix are the independent variables.
cues.zh: X 是設計矩陣，各欄是自變數。

cues.en: Beta is the vector of regression coefficients, and this is the thing we wanna solve for.
cues.zh: beta 是迴歸係數向量，就是要求解的量。

cues.en: And y is our dependent variable.
cues.zh: y 是依變數。

cues.en: Now, we want to solve for beta, we wanna isolate beta here.
cues.zh: 我們要解出 beta，把它單獨留在這裡。

cues.en: If this were just like a normal algebra equation with individual numbers, the solution would be really simple.
cues.zh: 如果只是含個別數字的一般代數方程式，解法非常簡單。

cues.en: We would just divide both sides of the equation by x, and then we get beta and y divided by x.
cues.zh: 兩側除以 X，就得到 beta 等於 y 除以 X。

cues.en: Unfortunately, it's not quite that simple here, and that's because x is not a number, it's a matrix, and it is not possible to divide a matrix,
cues.zh: 可惜這裡沒那麼簡單，因為 X 不是數字，而是矩陣，不能對矩陣做除法，

cues.en: linear algebra just doesn't have that concept.
cues.zh: 線性代數沒有這個概念。

cues.en: So what we need to do instead is multiply by x inverse.
cues.zh: 必須改成乘上 X 的反矩陣。

cues.en: And the inverse of a matrix is a matrix that cancels out another matrix.
cues.zh: 反矩陣是一個能抵消另一矩陣的矩陣。

cues.en: However, it turns out that x also does not have a full inverse because it is a tall matrix, so it has more rows than it has columns.
cues.zh: 但 X 沒有完整的反矩陣，因為它是高矩陣，列比欄多。

cues.en: So if you would print it out, the matrix would look like this.
cues.zh: 印出來會像這樣。

cues.en: And tall matrices do not have inverses, only square matrices have inverses.
cues.zh: 高矩陣沒有反矩陣，只有方陣才有。

cues.en: Fortunately, there is, if we assume some conditions on the design matrix, then we can apply something called the one-sided inverse,
cues.zh: 幸好，若設計矩陣符合某些條件，就可以使用所謂的單側反矩陣，

cues.en: in this case, it's the left inverse.
cues.zh: 這裡是左反矩陣。

cues.en: And that will actually allow us to solve this equation perfectly exactly.
cues.zh: 如此就能完美、精確地求解這個方程式。

cues.en: In a few moments, I'm going to talk about what those conditions are, but it's not so stringent.
cues.zh: 稍後會談這些條件，但不算嚴格。

cues.en: So we multiply by what's called the left inverse, which is the data matrix, or sorry, the design matrix x, transpose x,
cues.zh: 乘上所謂的左反矩陣，也就是資料矩陣——抱歉，是設計矩陣 X，先算 X 轉置乘 X，

cues.en: and then this whole thing inverted times x transpose.
cues.zh: 把整個量取反矩陣，再乘 X 轉置。

cues.en: Now it turns out that although x is not invertible, x doesn't have an inverse, x transposed times x does have an inverse.
cues.zh: 雖然 X 不可逆、沒有反矩陣，但 X 轉置乘 X 卻有反矩陣。

cues.en: It's one of these subtle but important features of matrix multiplication that you would learn about in a linear algebra course.
cues.zh: 這是矩陣乘法中，一個細微但重要的性質，線性代數課會學到。

cues.en: But now of course, what we do to one side of the equation, we have to balance on the other side of the equation.
cues.zh: 對方程式一側做的運算，當然也必須在另一側平衡。

cues.en: So we also have to multiply the left inverse over here on the right hand side of the equation.
cues.zh: 所以方程式右側，也必須乘上左反矩陣。

cues.en: Now this left inverse obliterates x, that gets rid of x, and that isolates our solution.
cues.zh: 左反矩陣會消去 X，讓要求的解單獨留下。

cues.en: So beta equals the left inverse of the design matrix times our dependent variable y, and this is the solution to the general linear model,
cues.zh: beta 等於設計矩陣的左反矩陣，乘上依變數 y，這就是一般線性模型的解，

cues.en: which means it's the solution to a regression model.
cues.zh: 也就是迴歸模型的解。

cues.en: Now this is great for many reasons.
cues.zh: 這有很多好處。

cues.en: It is really easy to fit, a computer can fit this model in microseconds.
cues.zh: 非常容易擬合，電腦可以在幾微秒內擬合。

cues.en: Even if you have a ginormous data set, it's still only gonna take seconds to fit this model.
cues.zh: 即使資料集巨大，也只需要幾秒。

cues.en: And it's a closed form analytic solution, so we can prove mathematically that this is the right solution, even without having any data.
cues.zh: 而且是封閉形式的解析解，即使沒有資料，也能從數學證明這是正確解。

cues.en: And furthermore, it always gives us the same solution.
cues.zh: 此外，總是給出相同解。

cues.en: This is not some kind of stochastic gradient descent operation where we can get stuck in local minima, and we get different answers every time we run.
cues.zh: 不像某種隨機梯度下降運算，可能卡在局部極小值，每次執行得到不同答案。

cues.en: Nope, this is a one shot deal, it's always going to be the right solution, this equation here.
cues.zh: 這是一次完成的方法，這個方程式總是給出正確解。

cues.en: So I mentioned that we have to impose a few conditions.
cues.zh: 提過需要一些條件。

cues.en: We have to make some assumptions on the design matrix x in order for this to be the correct solution, for this solution to work.
cues.zh: 為了讓這個解正確、可運作，必須對設計矩陣 X 做一些假設。

cues.en: So now I'm gonna tell you what those two conditions are.
cues.zh: 現在說明兩個條件。

cues.en: The conditions are that the matrix x needs to be a tall matrix, so that means that it's shaped like this.
cues.zh: 第一，矩陣 X 必須是高矩陣，也就是形狀像這樣。

cues.en: So there's more rows than there are columns, which means that there are more observations than there are features.
cues.zh: 列比欄多，表示觀察數多於特徵數。

cues.en: That means that if this is a regression model where people are your dependent variables, so you're measuring something from people, then you have more people
cues.zh: 若迴歸模型中，從人身上量測依變數，那麼人數要多於

cues.en: than you have independent variables.
cues.zh: 自變數數量。

cues.en: We can go back to the example model I described in the previous video.
cues.zh: 回到上一支影片的模型例子。

cues.en: So we're trying to predict height based on four terms.
cues.zh: 用四個項預測身高。

cues.en: We have the intercept, the sex, the parents' height, and the child nutrition.
cues.zh: 截距、性別、父母身高，以及兒童期營養。

cues.en: So in that case we had 10 people and four regressors.
cues.zh: 那時有 10 個人、四個迴歸變數。

cues.en: So this would be 10 rows and four columns of our design matrix.
cues.zh: 因此設計矩陣是 10 列、4 欄。

cues.en: So that is great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: Now, if you have taken a course on deep learning, or you've learned a little bit about deep learning or deep neural networks, then you might actually know that deep neural networks
cues.zh: 如果上過深度學習，或學過一點深度學習、深度神經網路，可能知道它們

cues.en: have the opposite problem, they tend to have wide design matrices where you have many, many more features than you have observations.
cues.zh: 面對相反問題，設計矩陣通常很寬，特徵數遠多於觀察數。

cues.en: So that actually means that for deep neural networks, you cannot use this solution, this solution is not going to work.
cues.zh: 因此，深度神經網路不能使用這個解，這個解無法運作。

cues.en: So you would need to apply some other techniques like regularization or gradient descent and so on.
cues.zh: 需要用其他技巧，例如正則化、梯度下降等等。

cues.en: So I'm not talking about that here.
cues.zh: 這裡不討論那些。

cues.en: For standard regression, standard general linear model, you need to have more data points than independent variables.
cues.zh: 標準迴歸、標準一般線性模型，需要資料點多於自變數。

cues.en: So that is the first condition for this solution to work.
cues.zh: 這是解法運作的第一個條件。

cues.en: The second condition is that your independent variables have to be independent of each other.
cues.zh: 第二，自變數必須彼此獨立。

cues.en: So independent independent variables, you cannot have independent variables that are scaler multiples of each other or that you could combine together
cues.zh: 獨立的自變數彼此也要獨立，不能有自變數是彼此的純量倍數，也不能把某些自變數組合，

cues.en: to perfectly recreate a different independent variable.
cues.zh: 完美重建另一個自變數。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Let me give you an example.
cues.zh: 舉個例子。

cues.en: So here we had our list of model equations that I showed in the previous video, and now remember here,
cues.zh: 這是上一支影片展示的一系列模型方程式，記得，

cues.en: the next step here was to convert this set of equations into one compact matrix vector equation.
cues.zh: 下一步要把這組方程式轉成精簡的矩陣向量方程式。

cues.en: So we get these numbers out and we put them into a matrix, and this is the design matrix x.
cues.zh: 取出數字，放進矩陣，就成為設計矩陣 X。

cues.en: Now look what's happened here.
cues.zh: 看看這裡發生什麼事。

cues.en: I actually have a repetition of this variable here, this was the parent's height.
cues.zh: 這個變數重複出現，這是父母身高。

cues.en: This is a mistake, actually, maybe you made a typo in your code, or someone was collating the data and they made a a simple mistake.
cues.zh: 這是錯誤，可能程式打錯字，或整理資料的人犯了簡單錯誤。

cues.en: But the point is here we no longer have independence amongst the columns in our design matrix, the columns have dependencies.
cues.zh: 重點是，設計矩陣各欄不再獨立，各欄有相依性。

cues.en: So the correlation matrix of this design matrix would have at least one correlation that is exactly one.
cues.zh: 這個設計矩陣的相關矩陣，至少會有一個相關精確等於 1。

cues.en: So this is not good, this gives us a reduced rank matrix, and the statistical term for this is multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 這不好，產生降秩矩陣，統計上稱為多重共線性。

cues.en: So kind of long word, multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 這個詞有點長，多重共線性。

cues.en: And you can see that the important part here is colinear.
cues.zh: 重要部分是共線。

cues.en: So these two are on the same line because they're actually exactly the same variable.
cues.zh: 這兩欄在同一直線上，因為其實是完全相同的變數。

cues.en: So if you have independent variables in your design matrix that are essentially measuring the same thing, then that's going to create multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 設計矩陣的自變數，如果本質上在量測相同東西，就會造成多重共線性。

cues.en: And again, that will mean that you cannot fit this model.
cues.zh: 同樣，這表示無法擬合模型。

cues.en: Now, if you have that kind of a situation, multicollinearity, it's almost certainly due to a mistake, in this case, the mistake was repeating this column twice.
cues.zh: 如果有多重共線性，幾乎肯定是錯誤造成的；這裡是同一欄重複兩次。

cues.en: So if you have multicollinearity and your statistic software, whether it's MATLAB or Python or R or SPSS, it's going to give you an error message.
cues.zh: 若有多重共線性，統計軟體不管是 MATLAB、Python、R 或 SPSS，都會給錯誤訊息。

cues.en: And it will say, of course, the error messages will vary, but it'll say something like, this model could not be computed, it might give you an error message about rank deficiency,
cues.zh: 訊息各有不同，但可能說無法計算模型，或提到秩不足，

cues.en: it might say multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 也可能說多重共線性。

cues.en: It will just be unable to, it might say that the matrix is singular and could not be fit.
cues.zh: 就是無法計算，也可能說矩陣是奇異的，不能擬合。

cues.en: So if you see any kind of error message, then the first thing you should do is check the design matrix, because it's likely that you have a situation of multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 看到這類錯誤，首先應檢查設計矩陣，因為很可能有多重共線性。

cues.en: And if you don't have multicollinearity and all of the columns in your design matrix are all independent of each other, I don't know if that has a specific statistical term.
cues.zh: 如果沒有多重共線性，設計矩陣各欄都彼此獨立，我不知道是否有特定統計術語。

cues.en: So I just call this a-okay, this is all good.
cues.zh: 所以就稱它為一切正常、完全沒問題。

cues.en: All right, so I would like to apologize again, if you don't have a linear algebra background and you feel a little bit confused about some of the math in this video,
cues.zh: 如果沒有線性代數背景，覺得這支影片的數學有點困惑，再次致歉，

cues.en: then don't worry about it, the important part is the conceptual idea of how the model parameters are fit, and the concept of multicollinearity
cues.zh: 不用擔心，重要的是模型參數如何擬合的概念，以及多重共線性的概念，

cues.en: that all of your columns in the design matrix, which means all of the independent variables, must be independent of each other.
cues.zh: 也就是設計矩陣所有欄、所有自變數，都必須彼此獨立。
